title: Authorize supplier comparison procurement sources and decisions
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require current enabled nondeleted authenticated identity and existing purchase-quote menu plus SalespersonDataScopeService for every supplier-comparison and approval entry. Scope SQL before counts/pages/all and derivations, including related price-history/variance/funnel routes so no source data leaks through sibling routes. These are authorization repairs to existing operational sources, no new report or legacy entry switch. Read batch history only for authorized persisted quote rows, no hidden-row counts/skip details. Explicit inaccessible or missing ids have controlled non-disclosing errors.

Authorize persisted customer before CRUD/decision mutation and proposed customer before create/reassignment. Never trust CustomerName, proposed ids, DecidedBy or snapshots as authority. Converted RefOrderNo can mean a purchase order; only verified existing conversion evidence may resolve generated order ownership, never infer sales ownership from ambiguous text. Null owner is available only under explicit unrestricted existing policy. Prefill and actual conversion also require existing purchase-order menu and authoritative destination scope through PurchaseOrderAuthorizationRules before numbers or writes. Mixed batch ids reject without partial information or writes; revoked access takes immediate effect. Do not expand grants.

Real isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover own/foreign/null owner, malformed/disabled/deleted/revoked identity, missing source/destination menu, forged customer/source/actor, foreign batch inclusion and every inherited/sibling route. Allowed own comparison and approval/prefill/conversion still function, denied operations leave rows, decisions, orders, inventory and finance unchanged. Reuse current entity/context contracts and compatible constructor call sites; no permissive test-only HTTP fallback.

implementation_evidence: PurchaseQuoteController inherits unrestricted BaseCrudController list/all/detail/create/update/delete/batch-delete and its prefill/single/batch conversion routes have class Authorize only. PurchaseQuoteDecisionController likewise lacks live module/customer scope. ERP020/027/095 implement conversion/approval; ERP371 guards canonical PurchaseOrderController but this separate conversion creates PurchaseOrders directly. ERP098/103/105 are read helpers, not source authorization. Source and task history show no equivalent guard.
